brief.summary: Equities are pulling back from record highs, with S&P and Nasdaq futures lower. Yields are higher across the curve, led by the long end at multi-decade highs, steepening the curve; high-yield spreads are widening and oil is up above $100 on Hormuz attacks. The Fed is seen hawkish: last meeting hiked, ~20% odds of an October hike, and one more hike this year is expected. The dominant narrative is competition for capital—heavy Treasury and AI-related corporate issuance—plus France's fiscal crisis and no ECB backstop. Tone is cautious despite AI optimism and equities near records.
notable_quotes: I don't see a way for higher interest rates to lower inflation without... the solution to higher rates is higher rates.
There is a sovereign bond crisis happening, and it's emanating from France.
